verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs describe bulk imports into database connections, gradual import-mode migration, and moving user data 'into and out of Auth0' with bulk imports and exports. That covers the core import/export round-trip. Nothing in the evidence says password hashes can be imported or exported, and that is the part of the story that actually prevents lock-in. Missing for 10: evidence that password hashes are accepted on import, evidence that hashes are included in exports, detail on export formats, independent hands-on corroboration.
